title: Browser visualizer for a tiny transformer
text: Builds a standalone HTML visualizer that animates the internals of a small decoder-only transformer trained on a single Shakespeare text file.

title: Mario-style platformer in Phaser
text: Generates a Super Mario-inspired platformer in Phaser 3 with jumping, patrolling enemies, collectible coins, a finish flag, scoring and win and lose states.

title: PDF page manager web app
text: Implements a Sinatra web app that adds or deletes PDF pages, converts pages to JPEG, and assembles JPEGs back into a PDF using ImageMagick.

title: Source code outliner
text: Writes a Rust command-line tool that parses source files with tree-sitter and prints hierarchical outlines of functions, structs, traits and modules.

title: Guardrailed customer email drafter
text: Drafts customer-service email replies for a peptide distributor in a web app whose guardrails keep every response within a research-use-only sales policy.

title: Daily options strategy generator
text: Generates short-term options trading strategies over configurable time periods to automate a daily trading analysis routine for an individual trader.

title: raylib bindings for Node
text: Generates N-API bindings for the raylib 5.5 game library from its API definitions, exposing it to Node and Bun as modern ES modules.

title: Dice to I Ching converter
text: Builds a web page that turns two eight-sided dice rolls into an I Ching hexagram, mapping the first roll to the lower trigram and the second to the upper.

title: Discord expense splitting bot
text: Writes a Discord bot that registers users and splits shared expenses among friends inside channels, in the style of Splitwise.

title: Tailored job application generator
text: Analyzes a candidate's profiles from several sources across several specialist roles and generates tailored application materials for each job opportunity.

title: Linux gaming and download tweak scripts
text: Writes shell scripts that tune Roblox on Linux with gamescope and graphics tweaks, and speed up Flatpak downloads through aria2 and regional mirrors.

title: On-device document scanner for iPhone
text: Builds an iPhone app that scans, OCRs and searches receipts, invoices, contracts and boarding passes entirely on-device so documents never leave the phone.

title: Thai typing practice web app
text: Builds a web app for learning to type Thai with word practice, pronunciation guides, sentence completion, conversation exercises and progress scoring.

title: Korean FastAPI beginner book
text: Writes a Korean-language book-length guide to FastAPI for beginners, covering routing, Pydantic validation and Python environment management with uv.

title: Self-hosted NWS weather station
text: Builds a self-hosted personal weather forecast app that shows live National Weather Service data and ships as a single Docker container behind nginx.

title: Private budget app for iPhone
text: Builds an installable iPhone budget app with monthly breakdowns, charts, debt tracking and per-category spending limits, requiring no account or bank connection.

title: Parallel research report pipeline
text: Decomposes a research query into subtopics, delegates each to a specialized researcher, synthesizes the findings into a report, and adds citations.

title: Image collection curation app
text: Builds an app for sorting large image collections spread across directories, surfacing duplicates and low-quality files so only the worthwhile ones are kept.

title: CommonMark parser with live demo
text: Implements a GitHub-flavored CommonMark parser in TypeScript using functional recursive descent, served with a live demo that renders HTML as you type.

title: Uniswap V4 position tracker
text: Builds a Next.js app with wallet connection that tracks and manages a user's Uniswap V4 liquidity positions.

title: Sliding block puzzle PWA
text: Builds a mobile-first sliding block puzzle PWA with 100 levels, a breadth-first-search solver that finds optimal paths, and PixiJS rendering of blocks and gates.

title: Physical robotics textbook site
text: Writes a Docusaurus book teaching real robotics systems, from ROS 2 robot modeling to Gazebo and Unity simulation and NVIDIA Isaac navigation.

title: Movie review sentiment classifier comparison
text: Trains logistic regression, random forest and SVM classifiers on movie reviews, tunes hyperparameters with cross-validation, and picks the best performer automatically.

title: Content summarizer for videos and papers
text: Turns YouTube videos, articles, research papers and podcasts into structured summaries and insights saved for later reference.

title: Tor and I2P Android radio player
text: Builds an Android radio player that streams stations over I2P, Tor or clearnet and supports Android Auto.

title: Morse code trainer for 3DS
text: Writes a Morse code training program that runs on the Nintendo 3DS handheld console, for learning to send and receive code.

title: Pomodoro timer with todo list
text: Builds a progressive web app that combines a Pomodoro timer with an integrated todo list, tested with Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests.

title: Bilingual art gallery website
text: Builds a bilingual English and Persian website on Next.js and Firebase to showcase a painter's work for an art and education center.

title: Markdown slides in the terminal
text: Builds a terminal presentation tool that turns markdown into slides with live code execution, images, diagrams and speaker notes.

title: English diagnostic and tutoring skill
text: Delivers English learning through a diagnostic assessment, targeted vocabulary instruction, performance evaluation and real-time grammar correction for beginners.

title: Crypto market intelligence desk
text: Coordinates several specialist roles with real-time tools for cryptocurrency market intelligence, defined in markdown with no orchestration code.

title: qPCR analysis pipeline
text: Analyzes QuantStudio qPCR output end to end: excludes wells, averages CT values, normalizes to housekeeping genes, computes fold change, and writes Excel files and bar charts.

title: Multi-tenant data isolation audit
text: Audits multi-tenant codebases for cross-account data isolation flaws by detecting the tech stack and running call-graph analysis over read and write paths.

title: iOS trivia app with live questions
text: Builds an iOS 26 Liquid Glass trivia app with nine categories, questions fetched live from the internet, and a thirty-second timer.

title: Spec-first todo app with CLI
text: Builds a task manager with both a command-line tool and a full-stack web app, following specification-first development.

title: Blog translation and redesign
text: Translates all 69 posts of a personal blog into Italian, redesigns the layout from scratch, adds a boot-sequence easter egg, and cleans up years of messy tags, tracked in git.

title: Docs restructure with redirects
text: Restructures a large API documentation site by moving and merging files, updating the navigation file, and setting up redirects from old URLs to new ones.

title: Emacs Obsidian package ported to Rust
text: Ports parts of an Emacs package for Obsidian vaults into Rust, cutting one operation from 90 seconds to about 15 milliseconds with almost no hand-written code.

title: Forum post bookmarking macro suite
text: Writes the JavaScript behind a Keyboard Maestro macro suite that saves forum topics, posts and attached macros into a browsable personal knowledge base.

title: RSS feed generator from a sitemap
text: Writes a script that builds an RSS feed from a site's sitemap file so a feed reader can follow sites that publish no feed.

title: App-store layer on top of GitHub
text: Builds an app-store-like browsing layer on top of GitHub to make finding good software easier than GitHub's own search and interface.

title: Sample pages from a UI component library
text: Generates realistic sample web pages using a component library, as a newcomer to frontend development exploring what the components can produce.

title: House-hunting property CRM dashboard
text: Pulls Zillow listings for house hunting near a national park into a triage dashboard with stage tracking, price history and days-on-market analysis on Cloudflare.

title: AirPlay receiver plugin for OBS
text: Implements the AirPlay protocol as an OBS Studio plugin on Windows, showing iPhone, iPad and Mac screen mirroring as a video source with synchronized audio.

title: Click-to-edit mode for HTML decks
text: Adds an edit button to a single-file HTML presentation so slide text can be dragged, retyped and pasted with screenshots in the browser, then saved.

title: Godot save system with arena demo
text: Writes a drop-in save and load system for Godot 4, demonstrated by a neon arena where four cubes collide and lose health.

title: Webcam hand gestures for notes
text: Turns a webcam feed into a gesture interface where markdown folders float as orbs and pinching, throwing or crushing with the hands manipulates notes.

title: Webcam street fighting game
text: Builds a webcam fighting game where a player stands side-on to a laptop and fights Ryu with real punches, kicks and blocks.

title: Heat diffusion in an iron cylinder
text: Solves transient axisymmetric heat diffusion in an iron cylinder with a sinusoidally heated end face using PETSc time steppers, and animates the temperature field.

title: Old iPhone as Mac control deck
text: Turns an old iPhone into a Stream Deck-style panel running in Safari that opens chosen Mac apps with a tap, with no jailbreak or installation.

title: Linux port of a VR desktop streamer
text: Ports a VR desktop streamer to Linux by reusing the macOS streamer's protocol libraries, sending desktop, audio and microphone to Quest, Pico and Vive headsets.

title: Multiplayer city builder with simulated citizens
text: Builds a browser multiplayer city builder with a three.js client and authoritative TypeScript server where every citizen finds housing and the nearest job along connected roads.

title: Guitar transcription tool without typing
text: Builds a plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript guitar transcription tool for personal use that needs no typing, with songs autosaved in the browser and exportable as JSON.

title: Pathfinder 1e rules automation module
text: Automates Pathfinder 1e class features, archetypes, racial traits, feats and spells in Foundry VTT so items do what their rules text says.

title: Deadlines pushed to iCloud calendar
text: Writes a small Windows Tkinter app that turns a typed assignment deadline into an iCloud calendar event over CalDAV, appearing on phone and tablet.

title: Local lead generation and outreach pipeline
text: Discovers local businesses, scores their web presence, generates personalized outreach with live demo pages, and sends emails and WhatsApp messages after a human approval at every send.

title: Photorealistic space exploration sandbox
text: Builds a photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 sandbox on an Iceland-like ocean planet of lava moss and basalt cliffs, with jetpack flight out to its moon.

title: Website auth and storage refactor
text: Replaces JWT sessions and IndieAuth tokens with database-backed revocable ones, adds refresh tokens, and swaps BoltDB for SQLite through Gorm in a personal website server.

title: Plain-language trading strategy backtester
text: Turns a plain-language trading strategy into a validated spec and signal function, backtests it on historical data, and audits the result for look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, missing costs and overfitting.

title: Metadata-stripped photo sharing site
text: Builds a single-page photo site with a thumbnail grid, full-screen swipe viewing, and location, date and device metadata stripped from every image.

title: NetHack-style terminal roguelike
text: Writes a NetHack-style roguelike in Python with curses where the player descends to level 6, retrieves a book, and escapes while the dungeon wakes.
